note: Names of env variables only. Never put a key value in this file.
jev_note: Only the Jev yes/no calls use the API (OpenRouter). typesafe/jev-router runs on Jev, and Jev picks which model answers each request. The reply names that model; the results keep it as routed_model. base_url is a plain URL, not a secret. The env variable JEV_BASE_URL overrides it if set. The key is in the env variable OPENROUTER_API_KEY, which the code also reads from the project .env file without printing it. Replace the model name with SET-ME and live mode stops.
profile_note: Local runs use the default steps above: bets, copy and design in manual mode (Claude Sonnet writes the replies). The online profile is for Vercel later, not now. Pass a profile name to load_models. The validate step is the same in both profiles.

local.note: The default above. generate_* steps are manual with sonnet. validate is typesafe/jev-router.

online.note: Used later on Vercel only. Writing (generate_*) calls deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro. Animation code (SVG and CSS) calls anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5. Section visuals call google/gemini-3.1-flash-image. All go through OpenRouter. validate stays on Jev, the same as local.

crawl.note: The fetch itself is code. Haiku (a Claude subagent, manual mode, no API key) reads the fetched pages and sums them up.

search.note: Research search. A Claude Haiku subagent, manual mode, no API key.

data_validation.note: Checks sources, quotes and links in research before it is used. A Claude Haiku subagent, manual mode, no API key.

roles_note: Four makers (Decisions Log row 38, supersedes 36). reasoning (Google Gemini 3.8 Flash): page setup (positioning, claims, checklists), the gap dossier, report prose; it never decides pass or fail. writer (Anthropic Opus 5.5): hero variants only. judge1 Jev (TypeSafe): audit and Gate 2. judge2 (OpenAI decisions): Gate 2. The writer's maker differs from both judges' makers.
